_om: EN produktdefinition för Clipr Website (F09/F32, 28 nov 2026). Mänsklig version: clipr-agency/kunskap/PRODUKT-199.md. Läses av engine/betalmejl.py; mottagningen (kop.js) måste ha samma värden (provas i prov.mjs). Ändra här först, aldrig bara på ett ställe.
ingar: A new homepage for your business, built from the photos, text and colours already on your website
Designed for phones and computers, with your booking or contact details up front
Changes until you are happy with it
The finished homepage, ready to publish, with step-by-step help putting it live on your own domain
ingar_inte: The other pages of your current website. The new homepage gathers your key information on one page
Your domain and hosting, which stay with your own provider
byggare_text: If your current site is built with Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, Weebly, Jimdo, GoDaddy Website Builder or Webnode, the new homepage cannot be uploaded there. You keep your domain, and publishing needs a hosting service that accepts an uploaded website.
